skill.name: enact-firecrawl
skill.description: Scrape, crawl, map, search, and extract website content through the Firecrawl API for AI-ready research workflows.
skill.summary: Convert web pages and search results into clean markdown, links, and structured data using Firecrawl.
skill.author: EnactProtocol

security_audit.summary: The skill is a transparent Firecrawl API wrapper with expected network access and a required API-key secret. Most high static key findings are false positives from legitimate secret handling, but screenshot capture and templated command argument interpolation create privacy and injection concerns that should be addressed before broad marketplace publication.

remediation.issue: User-controlled inputs are interpolated into the skill command string.
remediation.suggestion: Use a runtime-supported argv array or explicit safe argument binding so url, prompt, schema, and other fields cannot affect shell parsing.

remediation.issue: Screenshot capture can send visual page content to Firecrawl.
remediation.suggestion: Document screenshot privacy implications clearly and consider requiring explicit confirmation before requesting screenshot formats.

remediation.issue: The skill sends URLs, search queries, prompts, and schemas to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit private, credentialed, or sensitive pages unless they have authorization and accept Firecrawl processing.

content.value_statement: Web content is often hard to collect in a clean format for AI workflows. This skill uses Firecrawl to scrape, crawl, map, search, and extract structured website data.
actual_capabilities: Scrapes a single URL and returns Firecrawl content data.
Crawls a site with a configurable page limit.
Maps URLs from a website without scraping every page.
Searches the web through the Firecrawl search endpoint.
Extracts structured data from pages using a prompt and optional JSON schema.
Returns operation status, source URL or query, data, and error details.
limitations: Requires a valid FIRECRAWL_API_KEY secret before use.
Sends target URLs, prompts, schemas, and requested content to the Firecrawl API.
Crawl and extract jobs can time out after the configured polling window.
Results depend on Firecrawl access, site permissions, and the target website response.

use_cases.title: Collect documentation for AI analysis
use_cases.description: Crawl a documentation site and convert selected pages into markdown for review or summarization.

use_cases.title: Monitor public web information
use_cases.description: Search the web or scrape target pages to gather clean content for research notes.

use_cases.title: Extract structured page data
use_cases.description: Use a natural language prompt and optional schema to pull pricing, headlines, links, or metadata from pages.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single page capture.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to scrape this public URL as markdown: [URL]. Return the main content and page metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Crawl a small documentation site
prompt_templates.scenario: Collect several linked pages from one site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to crawl [DOCUMENTATION_URL] with a limit of 10 pages. Summarize the key topics found.

prompt_templates.title: Find relevant pages before scraping
prompt_templates.scenario: Discover URLs without collecting all page content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl map on [SITE_URL] and filter for pages related to [TOPIC]. List the most relevant URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Extract schema-based information
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced structured extraction from a page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl extract on [URL]. Extract [FIELDS] using a JSON schema, then explain any missing values.

output_examples.input: Scrape a product page and return markdown.
output_examples.output: The result includes a success flag, the scrape action, the source URL, markdown page content, and available metadata.

output_examples.input: Map a documentation website for API reference pages.
output: A list of discovered URLs is returned.
Relevant links can be filtered before deeper crawling.
No full page content is collected during mapping.

output_examples.input: Extract pricing plan names and prices from a public pricing page.
output_examples.output: The result contains structured extracted fields when Firecrawl can identify the requested data.

best_practices: Use the smallest crawl limit that can answer the task.
Scrape only public pages that you are authorized to process.
Store FIRECRAWL_API_KEY as a secret and rotate it if exposed.
anti_patterns: Do not scrape private, sensitive, or access-controlled content without authorization.
Do not request screenshots unless visual page content is required.
Do not send secrets, credentials, or private data inside extraction prompts or schemas.

faq.question: What does this skill need to run?
faq.answer: It needs a Firecrawl API key stored as the FIRECRAWL_API_KEY secret.

faq.question: Does this skill access the network?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends requests to the Firecrawl API and Firecrawl processes the target URLs or search queries.

faq.question: Can it crawl an entire website?
faq.answer: It can crawl reachable pages up to the limit you set. Large crawls may time out or require higher Firecrawl limits.

faq.question: Can it return screenshots?
faq.answer: The Firecrawl service supports screenshot output when requested in formats. Use this only when visual content is needed.

faq.question: Can it extract structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. The extract action accepts a natural language prompt and can also use a JSON schema string.

faq.question: Is this safe for private content?
faq.answer: Use caution. URLs, prompts, schemas, and returned content are processed by Firecrawl, so avoid private or sensitive data.
